```
typedef struct packed {
  logic [31:0] res;
  logic [9:0]  cls;
  logic [4:0]  sts;
  logic [1:0]  op;
} exp_t;

function automatic exp_t f_golden(input logic[31:0] a, input logic[31:0] b,
                                   input logic[1:0] op, input logic[2:0] mode);
  exp_t e;
  e = '{default:0};
  e.op = op;
  case (op)
  2'd0: begin // SGNJ
    case (mode)
      3'd0: e.res = {b[31], a[30:0]};
      3'd1: e.res = {~b[31], a[30:0]};
      3'd2: e.res = {a[31]^b[31], a[30:0]};
      default: e.res = a; // never driven
    endcase
    e.sts = 0;
  end
  2'd1: begin // MINMAX
    if (f_isnan(a) && f_isnan(b)) e.res = 32'h7FC00000;
    else if (f_isnan(a)) e.res = b;
    else if (f_isnan(b)) e.res = a;
    else if (mode==0) e.res = f_lt_minmax(a,b) ? a : b;
    else              e.res = f_lt_minmax(b,a) ? a : b;
    e.sts = (f_issnan(a)||f_issnan(b)) ? 5'h10 : 0;
  end
  2'd2: begin // CMP
    e.sts = 0; e.res = 0;
    if (f_isnan(a)||f_isnan(b)) begin
      e.res = 0;
      if (mode==3'd2) e.sts = (f_issnan(a)||f_issnan(b)) ? 5'h10 : 0;
      else e.sts = 5'h10;
    end else begin
      case(mode)
        0: e.res = (f_lt_ordered(a,b) || f_eq(a,b)) ? 1 : 0;
        1: e.res = f_lt_ordered(a,b) ? 1 : 0;
        2: e.res = f_eq(a,b) ? 1 : 0;
      endcase
    end
  end
  2'd3: begin
    e.cls = f_class(a);
    e.sts = 0;
  end
  endcase
  return e;
endfunction
```
